title: Modern East Nashville Townhome
description:
We are excited to offer our beautiful town-home in downtown East Nashville for your friends and family to enjoy! We are close to downtown as well as some of our East Nashvillian's local hot spots. We are less than 10 minutes from downtown. Therefore, if you want to head downtown for the music city night life or a quiet place to get away we would love to make your time in Nashville memorable.

The space
Our town-home offers many areas to make yourself at home.  Our beautiful brand new 2 bedroom 2.5 bath provides all the amenities to enjoy a home away from home. We offer 3 queen size beds, as well as a twin size fold out chair in a top floor in a common space. Our master bathroom provides a beautiful walk in shower and closet with a his/her's sink. The spare bedroom offers a walk in closet along with a full size bathroom. We also provide games to play if you want to enjoy a game night. We have an open floor plan from our living room to our kitchen. Our kitchen is fully equipped with all the tools you need to enjoy a homemade meal. We also offer beverage delivery. If communicated prior to check-in we can have the refrigerator stocked with alcoholic or non-alcoholic beverages of your choice. Rather if it is making a cup of coffee/tea to relax on the couch by the fireplace, or relish the nice fresh air on the balcony. We would love to host our home for you, and make your stay in Nashville fun and relaxing.

Guest access
We offer a key-less entry to provide a hassle free check in. You are able to access the entire house to yourselves, excluding one hall closet we will keep locked.
